topic: Roger Shepard & Jacqueline Metzler (1971) 10-Cube 3D Mental Rotation, Linear 60-Degrees-Per-Second Slope, and Parietal-Premotor Simulation
act5_climax_episode: Neuroimaging and spatial training proving parietal and premotor hand circuits physically simulate 3D block rotation.
